name: @wa-campaigns/agent-toolkit
stderr:
Unknown command: stdio

wa — WhatsApp Campaigns agent CLI v0.1.10

Usage:
  wa capabilities
  wa search [query] [--channel WHATSAPP] [--category KEY] [--sort rating|used]
  wa get <id>
  wa render <id> [--var key=value ...]
  wa create --file <template.json>
  wa clone <id>
  wa submit <id>
  wa send <blueprintId> --to +1555... [--to ...] [--var key=value ...] [--name "..."]
  wa upload-image (--file <image.png> | --from-url <https-url>)   # returns the GCS URL
  wa knowledge <id> (--get | --set-file <doc.md> | --delete | --enable | --disable)
  wa usage

Surveys:
  wa surveys [query] [--status DRAFT|SCHEDULED|ACTIVE|CLOSED]
  wa survey get <id>
  wa survey create --file <survey.json>
  wa survey update <id> --file <patch.json>
  wa survey submit <id>
  wa survey send <id> [--to +1555... ...] [--audience <audienceId> ...]
  wa survey send-test <id> --to +1555...
  wa survey sends <id>
  wa survey results <id>

Everything else, straight from the tool catalog (scope shown after each):
  wa template update <id> [--name <string>] [--description <string>] [--channel <string>] [--category <string>] [--content <object>] [--tags <array>] [--knowledgeDoc <string>]   # campaigns:write
  wa template duplicate <id>   # campaigns:write
  wa template delete <id>   # campaigns:write
  wa survey render <id>   # surveys:read
  wa survey clone <id>   # marketplace:clone
  wa survey delete <id>   # surveys:write
  wa audiences [--q <string>] [--page <number>] [--pageSize <number>]   # audiences:read
  wa audience get <id>   # audiences:read
  wa audience contacts <id> [--q <string>] [--page <number>] [--pageSize <number>]   # audiences:read
  wa audience create --name <string> [--description <string>] [--source <string>] [--contacts <array>]   # audiences:write
  wa audience import <id> --contacts <array>   # audiences:write
  wa audience delete <id>   # audiences:write
  wa conversations [--search <string>] [--unread] [--unassigned] [--assignedTo <string>] [--broadcastId <string>] [--page <number>] [--pageSize <number>]   # conversations:read
  wa conversation get <id> [--limit <number>]   # conversations:read
  wa reply <id> --kind <string> [--text <string>] [--mediaUrl <string>] [--blueprintId <string>] [--variables <object>]   # conversations:write
  wa conversation assign <id> --userId <string|null>   # conversations:write
  wa webhooks   # webhooks:manage
  wa webhook create --url <string> --events <array> [--description <string>]   # webhooks:manage
  wa webhook update <id> [--url <string>] [--events <array>] [--description <string|null>] [--active]   # webhooks:manage
  wa webhook delete <id>   # webhooks:manage
  wa webhook test <id>   # webhooks:manage
  wa contacts [--q <string>] [--status <string>] [--tag <string>] [--audienceId <string>] [--page <number>] [--pageSize <number>]   # contacts:read
  wa contact get <id>   # contacts:read
  wa contact update <id> [--firstName <string|null>] [--lastName <string|null>] [--email <string|null>] [--attributes <object|null>] [--tags <array>]   # contacts:write

  Any catalog tool name also works as typed (wa list_conversations, or
  wa list-conversations). Structured arguments come from --file <doc.json>:
  an object merges at the top level, a bare array fills the tool's list argument.
  Repeat a flag or comma-separate it for lists (--event a --event b).

Config: --key/WA_AGENT_KEY (required),
        --url/WA_GATEWAY_URL (optional; defaults to the hosted gateway)
